region: Cederberg, Tankwa Karoo, Swartberg and the Cape Peninsula
title: South Africa — Rock Art, Karoo Passes and the Two Capes
subtitle: A 14-day rooftop-tent loop from Cape Town through the Cederberg, Tankwa, Die Hel and De Hoop
summary: Self-drive in a kitted 4x4 with rooftop tents: Cederberg rock art, Wolfberg Arch, Swartberg Pass, Gamkaskloof, Cape Agulhas and Cape Point, framed by Robben Island and District Six.
introduction: Two days in Cape Town set the history: the District Six Museum, Bo-Kaap and the ferry to Robben Island. Then a double-cab Hilux with two rooftop tents takes the group north on the N7 to the Cederberg, where San paintings sit under sandstone overhangs and the Wolfberg Arch is an eight-hour day. The route crosses the empty gravel of Tankwa Karoo National Park, climbs the Swartberg Pass and drops into Gamkaskloof, a valley that had no road until 1962. It ends at De Hoop's dunes, Cape Agulhas, Simon's Town penguins and the cliffs of Cape Point.

exceptional.vsOman: Oman is desert, wadis and Arabian fort culture. This is a Mediterranean-climate mountain and Karoo loop with fynbos, sandstone arches, passes and apartheid-era and San history, driven on the left.
exceptional.vsPackageTourism: Package tours do Table Mountain, Cape Point and Garden Route. This itinerary replaces them with Cederberg rock art, unpaved Karoo passes and a night in Gamkaskloof, using a self-contained rooftop-tent vehicle.
exceptional.vsPortfolio: No other destination in the portfolio combines a European-style road infrastructure, high-standard camping and two ocean tips of Africa with the apartheid story in a single compact loop.

marchSuitability.summary: Cooler by a few degrees, long days and warm sea; still hot for midday hiking, dry, with continuing fire restrictions.

travelStyle.summary: Self-drive in a kitted 4x4 with rooftop tents, mixed with guesthouses and short guided or ferry activities.

transport.summary: Cape Town airport, ride-hailing for the city, then a double-cab 4x4 from day 4 to day 13.

modes.description: Hilux/Land Cruiser campers from Bushlore and Britz; Cape Town pick-up (verified).
Cape Town days 2–3 and airport transfers.

transport.carRental: Britz: minimum age 25 (23–25 with surcharge), 5-day minimum, licence held for over 3 years. Bushlore: Hilux/Land Cruiser roof-tent campers, rates in PDFs. Gravel-road, tyre and windscreen exclusions to be confirmed; cross-border not part of this plan.

drivingRequirements.summary: Drive on the left; avoid night driving; fuel stops are sparse in the Karoo.
drivingRequirements.internationalDrivingPermit: Conditional on licence country and format: an English-language licence with photo and signature is generally accepted; otherwise an IDP is advisable. Not verified today.
drivingRequirements.licenceNotes: Two travellers hold car licences and both are named on the rental. The other two are passengers.
drivingRequirements.motorcycleNotes: No motorcycles; use car passenger seats, ride-hailing or guided tours.
drivingRequirements.recommendedApproach: Two named drivers alternate; no driving after dark; keep fuel above half a tank on rural legs.

accommodation.summary: Rooftop tents on 5 nights (days 4, 5, 6, 7, 11); guesthouses or reserve cottages on the others.

camping.summary: Private and CapeNature campsites; Algeria's campsite is closed after floods; fires including gas cookers are forbidden in the Cederberg mountains.

physicalDifficulty.label: demanding
physicalDifficulty.summary: Heat, an 8 h hike and long gravel days; no technical skills.

itinerary.summary: 14 days from Cape Town through the Cederberg, Tankwa, Montagu, Swartberg/Gamkaskloof and De Hoop, returning via Cape Agulhas and Cape Point.

advantages: Self-drive in a developed road network with campsites and guesthouses.
Rock art, apartheid history and dramatic mountain passes in one loop.
Low local costs: food, guesthouses, fuel.
disadvantages: High violent-crime risk requires discipline (no night driving, no unguided city walks).
Heat limits hiking in the Cederberg and Karoo.
Rooftop-tent rental raises the cost near the €2,000 threshold.
uncertainties: Rental terms on gravel, tyres and windscreen are not verified.
Smartraveller and US State Department levels were not read; France Diplomatie's colour was not visible.
Flights, ZAR rate, Robben Island and Wild Card prices are estimates.
